name: Imperial Dragon Potion

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
During your daily preparations, you can spend 10 minutes to create a variant energy breath potion, which has the kobold trait in addition to its normal traits. The variant potion is influenced by imperial dragon magic, granting it the effect corresponding to your dragon benefactor; the DC for the breath is the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The potion becomes inert if not used by your next daily preparations, so it has no value if sold.
Dragon | Effect (Save) |
Forest | Insects dealing piercing damage in a 15-foot cone (Reflex save) |
Sea | Water dealing bludgeoning damage in a 30-foot line (Reflex save) |
Sky | Lightning dealing electricity damage in a 30-foot line (Reflex save) |
Sovereign | A psychic roar dealing mental damage in a 15-foot cone (Will save) |
Underworld | Flames that deal fire damage in a 15-foot cone (Reflex save) |
